name: Shenzhen Hipine Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Hipine Precision Technology Co., Ltd., incorporated in 2013 and headquartered in Shenzhen, and its subsidiaries design, develop, make and sell watches and related accessories in China. Its HIPINE and Goldbear brands cover gold-case watches, smart wearable jewelry and precious metal smart watches. It also provides original design manufacturing and subcontract processing, and sells through distributors, retail outlets and online stores.
